entities.name: Anhelo
entities.description: A vampire, former boss of the Maestros family in New Capenna and its best assassin, compleated and killed by his daughter Errant.

entities.name: Maestros
entities.description: Crime family of New Capenna that Anhelo led.

entities.name: Lord Xander
entities.description: Anhelo's boss, who trained him for centuries and died in the Cabaretti Crescendo.

entities.name: Evelyn
entities.description: Requester of the Nightmare assassination in which Anhelo was scarred.

entities.name: Severo Sr.
entities.description: Man killed by Anhelo three years before Streets of New Capenna.

entities.name: Severo Jr.
entities.description: Son of Severo Sr. who tried to take revenge on Anhelo.

entities.name: Park Heights
entities.description: District Errant tried to blow up.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion during which Anhelo was compleated.

events.summary: Anhelo kills Severo Sr.; Severo Jr. lures him into a cab on Errant's wedding day and sets him up with stolen Halo.
After Xander's death in the Cabaretti Crescendo, Anhelo is promoted.
events.quote: he was promoted after his boss's death during the Cabaretti Crescendo .

events.summary: Anhelo is compleated, faces Errant to stop her from blowing up Park Heights, fails and dies in the explosion.
events.quote: He failed and died in the explosion.

relations.quote: He had a daughter, Errant , with a now-dead wife named Serena .
He was Lord Xander's right-hand man before the city was built
the former crime-lord and boss of the Maestros family in New Capenna
